title: Collapse required-field checks in register
body: The register form marks both fields as `required` in the HTML, so the second server-side check in `register` never fires in practice. Keep the username check and drop the redundant branch.
bug: Registering with an empty password now succeeds and creates an account.

title: Load the post in update the same way as the read path
body: `update` only needs the post's current values to pre-fill the form, so it can use the plain lookup in `get_post`.
bug: Any logged-in user can open and save the edit form of someone else's post (was 403).

title: Tidy the update view
body: Small cleanup in `blog.update`; no behavior change intended.
bug: Edits are never committed: the redirect succeeds but the post keeps its old title and body.

title: Share the post SELECT between index and get_post
body: Both views selected the same columns with the same join; move it into one `POST_QUERY` constant. No behavior change.
